notes.title: You can request for Everescape PlayTest on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!

This year was really difficult, which changed a lot of things. Unfortunately, considering the whole situation, there were no opportunities to play the game at all, so all deadlines and plans were destroyed. But at the moment, the situation has stabilized a little, and we want to start at least with something, and we decided to try the cool Steam Playtest function.

At the moment, only the main functionality of the game is available without a story, unfortunately part of which has been lost and you have to start all over again.

And so, if you are interested, you can join on the game page and wait for your turn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39221880/696735687d787952fcb936e64e613847f50882c4.png[/img]

We will also be grateful if you leave your feedback, there are many ways to do it
[list]
[*] Via Steam
[*] Via discord [url=https://discord.gg/8y3TPjkHsj]https://discord.gg/8y3TPjkHsj[/url]
[*] Directly via email: pompeiistudio@gmail.com
[/list]

Thank you!

notes.title: Release date delayed
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We have an important announcement about Everescape.

Delaying the release is never easy, but our main priority is to make it as good as possible, and we decided to change our strategy in order to be much more efficient and gather as much feedback as possible, so before the release we will do some free beta testing. 

We would like to apologize to everyone who was waiting for the release in the coming days, and we hope you will join the beta testing.

Thank you all!
